name: AppstoreSpy
description: Google Play and App Store market intelligence: app and developer lookup, free-text and structured search, reviews, chart rankings, similar apps, download and revenue estimates, keyword suggestions, LiveOps events and localized store listings. Every skill is a read.

extensions.description: Skills are MCP tools served over Streamable HTTP; a skill id is the tool name. There is no A2A JSON-RPC endpoint, so a client must speak MCP.
The REST API behind these skills, and where to discover it.

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: API-KEY
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: AppstoreSpy API key, issued at https://appstorespy.com/account

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: The same API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

skills.name: Search apps
skills.description: Free-text search over app listings on one store, returning a ranked list. Use this when you have a name or a phrase. To select apps by revenue, downloads, category or rating instead, use filter_apps, which is far more precise.

skills.name: Get app
skills.description: Full listing for one app. The id is the bundle id on Google Play (com.twitter.android) and the numeric App Store id on iOS (333903271).

skills.name: Filter apps
skills.description: Search apps by structured criteria: revenue, downloads, rating, category, developer, release and update dates, countries of availability. This is the main market-research tool and the one to reach for over search_apps whenever the question is about a segment rather than a name.

skills.name: Summarise apps
skills.description: Aggregate totals for every app matching a filter, without returning the apps. Use this first to size a segment: it answers 'how many apps and how much revenue' in one call, where paging through filter_apps would cost many.

skills.name: Get similar apps
skills.description: Apps the store lists as similar to a given app. `link` set to `to` returns what the store shows on this app's page; `from` reverses the question and returns the apps that list this one as similar to them, which is how you find who is competing for its audience.

skills.name: Get app reviews
skills.description: User reviews for one app. Reviews are storefront- and language-specific, so country and language change which set comes back rather than just how it is rendered.

skills.name: Get chart rankings
skills.description: Chart positions over a date range, one row per app per chart per day. A chart is the triple (country, category, collection), plus platform on the App Store.

skills.name: Search developers
skills.description: Free-text search over developers. The query also accepts `field:value` terms, for example `hq_country:US`.

skills.name: Get developer
skills.description: One developer record, including publisher identifiers and headquarters country.

skills.name: Filter developers
skills.description: Search developers by structured criteria, with paging and sorting.

skills.name: Get download and revenue estimates
skills.description: Download and revenue estimates for one or more apps over a date range.

skills.name: Get keyword suggestions
skills.description: Google Play search autocomplete for a term. Answers 202 with a partial result while a fresh crawl runs, so call again shortly for the complete set.

skills.name: Get LiveOps events
skills.description: LiveOps events Google Play shows on an app listing: sales, tournaments, updates and new content. Answers 202 while a fresh crawl runs.

skills.name: Get app listing
skills.description: The Google Play store listing of one app for a country and language exactly as Google Play serves it: title, short and full description, what's new, icon, feature graphic, trailer and screenshots. Accepts any Google Play Console locale, not only the languages get_app stores, so use it for localized metadata such as Indonesian, Thai or Portuguese (Portugal). The listing is crawled on demand and kept; answers 202 while the crawl runs, so call again shortly. `translated` is true when Google Play shows a machine translation because the developer has not supplied that language.
